I replied to Marcus in a thread on his message in #north-random. I confirmed the corrected deadline: Thornbury Cloth Co.'s signed order form is due 19 November. He said no action was needed, so I didn't post anything else.

The workspace brain saves channel messages automatically, so his correction is on record there with his name and the time. I didn't look at his earlier post in #north-team or change it, since he didn't ask me to.
